newsitem.title: BELGIUM: PixTech hopeful despite Q2 losses.
newsitem.headline: PixTech hopeful despite Q2 losses.

text.p: PixTech Inc. of Santa Clara, California, said on Wednesday it was hopeful of a recovery after second quarter net losses dipped despite a continued decline in revenues.

Second quarter 1997 net loss for the EASDAQ-quoted firm eased to $3.5 million from $3.7 million in the first three months of the year, although this was still well above the net loss of $1.6 million in the first quarter of 1996.
Revenues slipped to $1.3 million from $1.6 million in the first three months of this year and $2.9 million for the first quarter of 1996.
But product sales were $255,000 compared to $173,000 during the first quarter of 1997, and $178,000 for the first quarter of 1996.
However, the company said in a statement released in Brussels that it was looking forward to making field-emission displays (FEDs) at a competitive cost next year.

In particular it had recently won an order to supply 50,000 FEDs over a five year period, and had been granted a development contract by the French government to develop FED displays suitable for multimedia applications.
Under the terms of this contract, they are to receive a zero-interest loan of $2.0 million, to be repayed in the years 2003 and 2005.
